mapper.delete: DELETE FROM STAT_DAILY WHERE STAT_DATE = CAST(#{statDate} AS DATE)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO STAT_DAILY (STAT_DATE, STAT_TYPE, STAT_KEY, STAT_VALUE, REGIST_DT) SELECT CAST(#{statDate} AS DATE), 'BOARD', BOARD_TYPE, COUNT(*), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM BOARD WHERE BOARD_TYPE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY BOARD_TYPE

INSERT INTO STAT_DAILY (STAT_DATE, STAT_TYPE, STAT_KEY, STAT_VALUE, REGIST_DT) SELECT CAST(#{statDate} AS DATE), 'LOGIN', 'TOTAL', COUNT(*), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM AUDIT_LOG WHERE EVENT_TYPE IN ('LOGIN_SUCCESS', 'API_LOGIN') AND REGIST_DT >= #{startDate} AND REGIST_DT < #{endDate}

INSERT INTO STAT_DAILY (STAT_DATE, STAT_TYPE, STAT_KEY, STAT_VALUE, REGIST_DT) SELECT CAST(#{statDate} AS DATE), 'ACCESS', 'TOTAL', COUNT(*), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM AUDIT_LOG WHERE EVENT_TYPE IN ('MENU_ACCESS', 'PII_VIEW', 'PII_DOWNLOAD', 'API_ACCESS') AND REGIST_DT >= #{startDate} AND REGIST_DT < #{endDate}

INSERT INTO STAT_DAILY (STAT_DATE, STAT_TYPE, STAT_KEY, STAT_VALUE, REGIST_DT) SELECT CAST(#{statDate} AS DATE), 'LECTURE_COMPLETE', 'TOTAL', COUNT(*), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM LECTURE_PROGRESS WHERE COMPLETED_YN = 'Y' AND COMPLETED_DT >= #{startDate} AND COMPLETED_DT < #{endDate}

INSERT INTO STAT_DAILY (STAT_DATE, STAT_TYPE, STAT_KEY, STAT_VALUE, REGIST_DT) SELECT CAST(#{statDate} AS DATE), 'SURVEY_PARTICIPATION', 'TOTAL', COUNT(*), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM SURVEY_PARTICIPATION WHERE SUBMIT_DT >= #{startDate} AND SUBMIT_DT < #{endDate}
mapper.select: SELECT STAT_DATE, STAT_TYPE, STAT_KEY, STAT_VALUE, REGIST_DT FROM STAT_DAILY WHERE STAT_DATE = CAST(#{statDate} AS DATE) ORDER BY STAT_TYPE, STAT_KEY
